slot.brief: Two identical speakers (or coherent sources) with given path difference at a point; decide constructive/destructive interference and compute resultant intensity ratio.

stem: Two identical coherent sources produce waves of wavelength $\lambda$. At a point where their path difference is $\dfrac{\lambda}{4}$, what is the resultant intensity relative to the intensity produced by either source alone?

verdicts.working: The phase difference is $2\pi(\lambda/4)/\lambda=\pi/2$. Thus $I_R=I+I+2I\cos(\pi/2)=2I$, twice the intensity from either source.

working:
$\phi=\dfrac{2\pi}{\lambda}\,\dfrac{\lambda}{4}=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$.
$\dfrac{I}{I_0}=4\cos^2\left(\dfrac{\phi}{2}\right)=4\cos^2\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)=2$.

Independent check: The phase difference is $2\pi(\lambda/4)/\lambda=\pi/2$. Thus $I_R=I+I+2I\cos(\pi/2)=2I$, twice the intensity from either source.
